fixes.why: Prevents synchronous image decoding of the large 1536x1300 WebP layers from blocking the main thread during initial load.

fixes.what: Increase `.motion-toggle` width and height from `36px` to `44px` (or add an invisible `::after` hit area of `inset:-4px`).
fixes.why: Meets the 44x44px touch target accessibility guideline (WCAG 2.5.5) matching the adjacent `.nav-toggle` and `.nav-icon` controls.

fixes.what: Replace `border-top:1px solid rgba(201,158,92,.3)` on `.site-footer__bottom` with `border-top:2px solid rgba(201,158,92,.3)` (or remove the border and rely on spacing).
fixes.why: Strictly enforces the brand and codebase rule of no 1px hairlines anywhere (`2px` rules only).

fixes.what: Wrap `gsap.quickSetter(l, 'y', 'px')` outside `applyParallax` instead of calling `gsap.set(l, ...)` inside the `ScrollTrigger` `onUpdate` loop.
fixes.why: Avoids object allocation and tween-lookup overhead on all four canopy layers on every single scroll tick.
